name: @ausm/monorepo
description: AUSM Monorepo - Activity Understanding and Scaffolding Medium

scripts.build: npm run build:phase1 && npm run build:phase2 && npm run build:phase3
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/core && npm run build && cd ../bridge && npm run build && cd ../ausm && npm run build
scripts.dev: cd packages/core && npm run dev & cd packages/bridge && npm run dev & wait
scripts.clean: cd device-macos/text-selection && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/screen-stream && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/viewport-manager && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/material-manager && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/text-input && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/cursor-plus-plus && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/screenshot-detector && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/clipboard-monitor && npm run clean && cd ../../device-macos/camera && npm run clean && cd ../../packages/detector-pipeline && npm run clean && cd ../../packages/core && npm run clean && cd ../../packages/bridge && npm run clean && cd ../ausm && npm run clean && cd ../../material-chat && npm run clean
scripts.build:phase1: cd packages/core && npm run build:base && cd ../../device-macos/text-selection && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/screen-stream && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/viewport-manager && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/material-manager && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/text-input && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/cursor-plus-plus && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/screenshot-detector && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/clipboard-monitor && npm run build && cd ../../device-macos/camera && npm run build && cd ../../packages/detector-pipeline && npm run build
scripts.build:phase3: cd packages/bridge && npm run build && cd ../../material-chat && npm run build && cd ../packages/ausm && npm run build
